title: Reporting Resource
description: Secret-free authenticated descriptor for an exact reporting materialization. The AdCP resource_ref is stable for this descriptor; native_version_ref is optional method evidence and may differ when the same AdCP revision is materialized again. Callers resolve access through the previously validated destination/share binding, never from credentials embedded here.

resource_ref.description: Seller-issued opaque reference to this exact authenticated resource descriptor.

kind.description: Shape through which the revision is consumed.

location.description: Non-secret provider-native object, relation, or share identifier. MUST NOT contain an activation URL, signed URL, bearer token, password, private key, or embedded credential.

native_version_ref.description: Optional immutable provider-native table version, transaction, snapshot, manifest generation, job, or run reference. It supplements but never replaces reporting_revision_id.

expires_at.description: When this resource stops being resolvable under the advertised retention contract, if bounded more narrowly than capability retention.

reader_compatibility.description: Reader features or format constraints required to consume this resource. Readiness verification MUST use a representative supported reader.
